entry.title: New: dsh-messaging#messaging-core
entry.summary: Unified messaging gateway for DeepSeek Harness: 27 IM platforms (Telegram, QQ, WeChat, Discord, WhatsApp, Feishu and more) in one plugin, with QR scan-to-authorize, per-platform workspaces, slash commands, and a web setup dialog. Exact install spec: github:534119219/dsh-messaging#path:/packages/messaging-core. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
